scope: Surgical hotfix only; no planner, routing, UI, trip-structure, accommodation, or roadtrip-engine logic changed.
root_cause: The deployed 1.9.3 app.js still registers submitTripForm inside initialize(). If initialize() fails or stalls before that point, window.reisslimSubmitTrip never exists and critical-ui.js shows 'De planner is nog niet volledig geladen.'
fix: Move submitTripForm and window.reisslimSubmitTrip assignment before initialize(), with the function correctly closed.
